title: Gear shipping & local suppliers — cheat sheet
content:
Purpose: quick reference for shipping demo gear, on-site AV rentals, and expense handling when traveling for customer events or conferences. Keep this in my Drive and copy into the event-specific doc.

Top priorities (quick):
- Ship demo units early (T-7 days to venue) if possible. Air courier for batteries requires paperwork (see HAZMAT below).
- Book local AV rental for stage/backdrop 48–72 hours before load-in.
- Scan and attach all receipts to Concur within 72 hours of purchase for expense reconciliation.

Packing & labeling checklist (for each crate):
- Itemized packing list taped to inside lid + copy in Google Drive.
- Fragile + orientation labels, "Handle with care — demo electronics".
- Include 2 spares: power brick, USB-C cable, HDMI adapter, ethernet dongle.
- Insurance tag: Policy #RWI-TRAVEL-2024 (procure special coverage for >$5k).

HAZMAT / batteries notes:
- Lithium ion batteries: ship as "By Air: UN3481 — packed with equipment" only if carrier accepts. Must declare watt-hour rating on paperwork.
- If >100Wh, need airline approval for cargo; ground courier recommended.
- Keep original batteries/serial numbers list in Drive for customs.

Recommended local suppliers (first-call list) — Bay Area & LAX examples (add city-specific copies):
- BayCity AV Rentals — Sound & Stage Co. Contact: Jenna Park, jpark@soundstage.co, +1 415-555-2148. Typical rate: $220/day basic AV package (projector, mic, 1 tech).
- West Coast Couriers — same-day crate pickup & delivery. Contact: Marco Ruiz (account), marcor@westcoastcouriers.com, +1 888-555-3003. 2-person lift fees apply.
- LAX Tech Rentals — Contact: Omar Singh, ops@laxtechrentals.com, +1 310-555-0789. Good for hand-carry backup gear.
- GlobalFreight Solutions — customs broker for international shipments. Sales: Sophie Chen, sophie.c@globalfreight.example, +44 20 7946 2000.

Timing & milestones (working template):
- T-21 days: confirm demo unit list, insurance, and customs broker (if intl).
- T-14 days: book AV rental + courier, request quotation and hold equipment.
- T-7 days: ship crates, share tracking and AWB with event ops + venue.
- T-2 days: confirm on-site arrival window and local contact.
- Day 0 (load-in): bring toolkit, gaffer tape, labels, backup laptop + charger, ethernet dongle.

On-site contact template (paste into event doc):
- Venue logistics manager: NAME / cell / email
- AV lead (vendor): NAME / cell / email
- Redwood lead on site: Priya Desai / +1 415-555-0102 / priya@redwood.ai
- Courier pickup: company / contact / pickup code

Expense capture rules (quick):
- Meals: itemized receipt required; no alcohol on corporate card unless approved.
- Taxis/rideshares: save receipt/transaction ID, note client name on expense line for client-facing demos.
- Rentals and courier invoices: request VAT-exempt or company billing address to speed reconciliation.
- Tip policy: reasonable local customary amounts ok, attach photo of receipt.

Common pitfalls & tips: 
- Vendors quoting "day" vs "event" rates — clarify hours and tech onsite hours (e.g., 0800–2000).
- Always confirm power panel specs with venue (208V vs 110V) for charging racks.
- If shipping internationally, include Pro-forma invoice with serial numbers to avoid customs delays.

Post-event:
- Confirm crate return pickup 24–48h after teardown.
- Log any damage with photos and vendor sign-off at pickup.
- Upload final invoices + photos to Confluence event folder and tag finance.

Notes to self (TODOs):
- Add curated list for EU cities (Berlin, London) — include VAT handling and broker contacts.
- Create mini checklist for hand-carry-only trips (no crate).
- Verify insurance POC and whether policy covers rental equipment.

Scratch area (raw quick notes):
- DHL sample AWB: 1234-5678-9012 (replace with real when booking).
- Concur project code: EVENTS-2026-DEMO (confirm with finance).
- Slack thread: #events-ops has photos from last show — check for lessons learned.

End of cheat sheet — copy & customize per event.
